mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.15% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates economic demand.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.15%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% in the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days due to earnings contraction fears.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous HOUST growth > 0.5% and RSAFS growth > 0.3% in the prior month indicate robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS growth rates exceed thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 0.5% combined with CPIAUCSL growth below 2.5% per annum signals stable manufacturing expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO growth > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL growth < 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: GDPC1 growth exceeding 1.0% annually reflects sustained economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 1.0% annually.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 4.0% triggers monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent PAYEMS growth > 0.3% and UNRATE decline > 0.1% in the prior month indicate accelerating labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.3% and UNRATE decline > 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL growth exceeding 3.0% annually signals inflationary pressure, prompting central bank rate hikes that cause negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 3.0%.
